ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure A, the two profile lines E—F and M—N intersect at point O; Figure B corresponds to the E—F profile, and the profile line overall descends from E toward F, with O located on this descending profile; Figure C corresponds to the M—N profile, and the profile is highest near O and descends toward both sides M and N. Then reason: The M—N transverse profile shows high in the middle and low on both sides, indicating that the area where O is located is locally raised; the E—F profile also shows that this raised area extends in one direction and has a slope. The terrain characteristics of being high in the transverse middle and low on both sides, and inclined along the extending direction, conform to a mountain ridge.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：观察甲图中 E—F 与 M—N 两条剖面线相交于 O；再看对应剖面，丙图的 M—N 剖面在 O 附近最高，两侧 M、N 较低，说明 O 所在地带是局部高起；乙图的 E—F 剖面整体由 E 向 F 降低，说明这个高起地带沿一个方向延伸并倾斜。把“横剖面中部高、两侧低”与“沿延伸方向有坡降”结合，判定该地形为山脊。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：甲图中，E—F 与 M—N 两条剖面线相交于 O 点；乙图对应 E—F 剖面，剖面线从 E 向 F 整体降低，O 位于这条下降剖面上；丙图对应 M—N 剖面，剖面在 O 附近最高，向 M、N 两侧降低。再推理：M—N 横剖面表现为中部高、两侧低，说明 O 所在地带是局部高起；E—F 剖面又显示该高起地带沿一个方向延伸并有坡降。横向中间高、两侧低，且沿延伸方向倾斜的地形特征符合山脊。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：甲图中，E—F 与 M—N 两条剖面线相交于 O 点；乙图对应 E—F 剖面，剖面线从 E 向 F 整体降低，O 位于这条下降剖面上；丙图对应 M—N 剖面，剖面在 O 附近最高，向 M、N 两侧降低。再推理：M—N 横剖面表现为中部高、两侧低，说明 O 所在地带是局部高起；E—F 剖面又显示该高起地带沿一个方向延伸并有坡降。横向中间高、两侧低，且沿延伸方向倾斜的地形特征符合山脊。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 无明显问题。候选推理先描述图像再推理，视觉描述与图中甲、乙、丙三图的剖面关系一致，结论与标准答案“山脊”一致。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：甲图中，E—F 与 M—N 两条剖面线相交于 O 点；乙图对应 E—F 剖面，剖面线从 E 向 F 整体降低，O 位于这条下降剖面上；丙图对应 M—N 剖面，剖面在 O 附近最高，向 M、N 两侧降低。再推理：M—N 横剖面表现为中部高、两侧低，说明 O 所在地带是局部高起；E—F 剖面又显示该高起地带沿一个方向延伸并有坡降。横向中间高、两侧低，且沿延伸方向倾斜的地形特征符合山脊。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Directly classifies the landform from the two given cross-section shapes: one section shows the crest across the feature, the other shows downslope along the feature. It uses the profiles themselves rather than reconstructing contour lines.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the image that 甲图 has two intersecting section lines E—F and M—N through O; 乙 is the E—F profile and 丙 is the M—N profile. In 丙, the profile from M to N rises to a high point near O and falls on both sides; in 乙, the profile from E toward F generally slopes downward through O.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text statement that 乙、丙分别对应沿甲图 E—F、M—N 所作的地形剖面, so the solver knows which profile direction to compare.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A ridge is a long, narrow elevated landform: in a transverse profile it appears as a local high with slopes down on both sides, while along its length it may slope downward. A valley would show the opposite transverse profile, with the middle lower than both sides.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：甲图显示 O 是 E—F 和 M—N 的交点；乙图说明 O 在 E—F 方向不是孤立峰顶，而是位于从 E 到 F 下降的斜面上；丙图说明 O 在 M—N 方向明显高于两端。由此排除山谷，因为山谷在横剖面应中间低；排除孤立山峰，因为 E—F 方向不是两侧都低、中央最高；也不符合鞍部。剩下的符合条件的是一条向 F 方向降低、两侧较低的高地，即山脊。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：甲图中，E—F 为一条水平剖面线，M—N 为一条竖直剖面线，两条线在 O 附近相交。乙图是沿 E—F 的剖面，剖面线从 E 向 F 方向总体下降，O 位于这个下降坡面上，不是两侧都低、中央突起的孤立峰顶。丙图是沿 M—N 的剖面，剖面呈中间高、两端低的拱形，O 位于最高部位附近，明显高于 M、N 两端。
再推理：如果是山谷，横剖面应表现为中间低、两侧高，但丙图显示 O 处中间高，所以排除山谷。如果是孤立山峰，沿 E—F 和 M—N 两个方向都应表现为中央最高、两侧较低，但乙图显示 O 只是位于从 E 到 F 下降的斜面上，所以排除孤立山峰。鞍部应表现为一个方向中间低、另一个方向中间高，也与乙图、丙图组合不符。图示特征更符合一条沿 E—F 方向向 F 降低、沿 M—N 方向两侧较低的高地，即山脊。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route reasons by eliminating competing landforms using the relative elevations implied by both sections at O, instead of directly applying a ridge-profile template. It contrasts ridge with valley, hill, and saddle.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from 乙图 that along E—F, O lies on the slope between a higher E side and a lower F side. Read from 丙图 that along M—N, O is higher than both M and N, forming a crest-like high point in that section. Read that both profiles share the same point O from 甲图.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt’s mapping of section lines to profile diagrams: E—F corresponds to 乙 and M—N corresponds to 丙; use the question’s request to name the landform.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Landform diagnostics: valley/gully has the center lower than both sides in a cross-section; a hill/peak would tend to be high in all directions with closed concentric contours; a saddle has a low point between two highs. If a point is high relative to the two sides in one direction but continues as a sloping high line in another direction, it is a ridge.
